title: 第5章 爆发
novel_title: 手握旧日权柄，弹幕硬说我是主角(灰烬暗燃)
content_zh: 安宏福刚想开口，可一时间却不知道该回答同意还是不同意。他为难的目光在风华瑾和神秘人之间来回游荡。神秘人注意到安宏福的异样，面具上露出的双眼锐利地打量了一下风华瑾。四目相对，空气安静异常，柜台后有些呆愣傻眼的安宏福感觉到了一股剑拔弩张的气氛。这时，神秘人突然抬起右手往前一挥，他身后的玻璃门瞬间自动敞开，他趁机后跳退出便利店转身就跑。风华瑾也夺门而出，紧追其后，眨眼之间，两人已奔出五十米开外。安宏福脖子一抻，脑袋向前探去，他有些不敢相信地揉了揉眼睛，觉得自已在做梦。锦辉街主路段，两道迅捷身影一前一后快速飞奔穿梭。“站住！其实我们可以谈谈！”风华瑾向着前方的人影高声喊道。神秘人没有回头，他竖起剑指，随之而动的是街道边的垃圾桶、碎石、树枝落叶，它们奇迹般地飘于半空，随着神秘人往后一指，快速撞向后面的风华瑾。风华瑾身形灵活地躲过飘散恶臭的垃圾桶等物，却发现逐渐被对方拉开了距离。神秘人抓住这个机会，本想再加快速度，一举甩开后面的追逐者。可下一秒，他一只脚踩在地面上，另一只停在半空，保持着奔跑的动作静止在了原地。“小瑾，我控制住他了！”神秘人的影子里，陆剑星的声音响起。听到声音，风华瑾不再担心随时可能飞来的阻挡物，猛地弓腰蹿了出去，直扑神秘人。神秘人瞳孔一缩，看见自已的影子被一只恶魔利爪般的大手紧紧攥住。无论他的意识有多么强烈，可身体仿佛不属于自已，完全动弹不了。眼见风华瑾就要冲过来，神秘人于心中默念了一个咒语：化水！身边水光波纹荡漾，神秘人的身体突然融化了，哗啦一声落在地面形成一滩流体，速度不慢地向前流淌，目标是前方下水道井盖。他的影子也随之消失，失去了阴影依赖的陆剑星则凭空出现于原地。陆剑星见那滩流体顺着井盖缝隙快速钻入，他抬手隔空一劈，一道隐约可见轮廓的风刃斩在剩余的一点流体上面。但这并没有阻止流体逃走，斩击的烟尘散去，他赶到那个井盖前，发现地上有不浅的斩痕，还有一片鲜红血迹。风华瑾随后赶到，看到地上的痕迹说道：“他受伤了，你对他的影子做标记了吗？”“标记了，他正在往南区方向逃跑。”陆剑星闭眼感知了一下回答道。风华瑾点了点头，略有思索，继续询问道：“要追吗？还是组织人手蹲点抓捕？”“我……唔呃……”陆剑星刚要说话，整个人忽地摇晃了一下，有血从嘴角流出。风华瑾立刻搀扶住他，忙问道：“你竟然也受伤了，什么时候？”“没事，很快就好，是那家伙破除了我的阴影标记，他很强。”陆剑星擦了擦嘴角。确认陆剑星没什么大碍后，风华瑾松了口气道：“嗯，根据安宏福的描述，他应该来自某个异端组织，以前我们从未接触过的异端组织。”她一边说着，一边将双手置于陆剑星的胸部，掌中有放射状光线照出。陆剑星只觉温暖遍布全身，刚才因阴影标记被破除受的伤很快就被治疗痊愈。“谢谢，我好多了。”他微笑表达谢意。风华瑾缓缓收回双手，将一缕头发撩至耳后问道：“现在该怎么办？”“先回去让安宏福签保密协议，然后回局里把情况汇报给队长。”“嗯，走吧。”……青藤市，南区，幸福小区。熟睡中的许牧只觉身边有人大吵大叫，让他异常烦躁，悠悠转醒。“没钱！追星都他妈把自已追成废物了！想买门票，自已赚钱去！”“1000块都没有吗！我就想看场演唱会怎么了啊啊啊！”“你已经高三了！你成绩已经垫底了，能不能把心思放在学习上！”睁开眼的许牧发现自已正坐在客厅的沙发上，茶几对面站着三个争吵的陌生人。就是这争吵的内容让他无比熟悉。等等，这不是401一家的争吵内容吗，他们怎么跑到我家客厅来吵了？对于这冒昧的一家三口，许牧额角跳动，他就算脾气再好，此刻也忍不住要发作。忽地，他发现了不对劲，房间的布局不对，这不是他家的客厅。难不成冒昧的是我？我大半夜跑人家客厅来了？许牧顿时泄气，一阵心虚，忙四下张望。脖子右拧，他看见旁边还坐着一个人，这人正翘着二郎腿，身体放松舒适地后靠沙发椅背。他着装打扮非常另类：棒球帽，森白笑脸面具，棕色皮夹克，卡其色工装裤，黑色作战靴。哟？左肩还有战损妆，这破损，这伤口，这血渍，真像那么回事啊。鼻尖耸动，许牧闻到了一股血腥味。这是真伤口！许牧一下清醒。他断定旁边的面具人绝不是这个家庭里的成员，他和自已一样，都是外来者。难道我出现在别人家客厅里跟他有关？“别瞎琢磨了，我们现在处于眼前这个女孩的潜意识空间里。”明朗的声音从面具下面传出。许牧从他的语气里感受不到恶意，他望向客厅里的高三女孩，转而对面具人提问：“为什么是我们两个，我是说，她为什么要把我们拉进她的潜意识空间？”“你误会她了，其实，拉我们进她潜意识空间的人是我。”面具人随意地回答道。礼貌：你吗？许牧差点脱口骂人，他捏了捏晴明穴，颇为无语：“给个交代。”“嘿嘿，抱歉，我说我不是故意的你信吗？”面具人身体前倾，倒了一杯茶，推给许牧，“我有一件超凡物品，它可以把一定范围内的超凡事物全部拉入集体潜意识空间里。”“本来我只想把自已和她拉进来，没想到这附近还有你这位超凡者。”他没心没肺地解释道。“前后矛盾，刚才你说的是‘她的潜意识空间’，现在是‘集体潜意识空间’。”许牧当即戳穿道。面具人哈哈一笑，回答道：“这并不矛盾，集体潜意识空间，就像个服务器，我们所有人的潜意识都可以连通这里。”他望向客厅中的争吵，继续道：“只不过我的超凡物品可以让她的潜意识着重表现，我们在观看她的故事，所以说这里是她的潜意识空间也没错。”许牧思考一下，指着女孩的父母道：“他们也是超凡者？”“不是，他们是女孩潜意识里自带的，类似幻象，他们本身的潜意识并不在这里。”面具人不假思索地解释，“这片空间里，只有你，我，她。”许牧隐约间猜到什么，从沙发上起身问道：“我不想掺和你们之间的恩怨，我该怎么离开这里。”“你可以自已想办法离开，或者等我办完事，使用超凡物品解除这片空间。”面具人看向许牧，“还有，这不是恩怨，是除害。”“除害？”许牧愕然反问。面具人也从沙发上站了起来，颔首道：“没错，她已经不能称为人类了，是被失控超凡因素污染的怪物。”怪物……许牧扭过头，不敢相信般看向女孩。啪！一个巴掌甩在女孩脸上。女孩父亲的手掌止不住颤抖，指着女孩大骂：“我们起码能供你吃，供你穿，你追的那个娘炮明星能给你什么！！他要演技没演技！唱歌都跑调！他就是个废物！没有那些脑残粉丝，他连条野狗都不如，这样的人，有什么让你喜欢的！再说你！你有什么脸拿着我们的钱，去倒贴讨好一条废物野狗！！！”女孩左脸被印上通红的掌印，她侧着被扇歪的脑袋，胸前剧烈起伏。“啊啊啊啊啊！！！！”她突然面容狰狞地尖啸起来。这动静像魔音贯耳，刺得许牧和面具人同时捂住了耳朵。“不许这么说我肖凡哥哥！！！啊啊啊啊！！！”咔！咔！咔！这一声出来，茶几、镜子、窗户等一切玻璃制品全部被震的开裂。许牧头晕目眩，双腿一软，直接跪到了地上，无数白色星星点点伴随耳鸣在眼前打转。要不是他有‘精神序列’初始节点不易陷入昏迷的加持，此刻早就两眼一黑昏过去了。一股温热的触感从鼻孔顺流而下，他抬手抹了一把，刺眼的血红铺满手背。抬头看了一眼面具人的情况，发现他已经昏倒在沙发上，脑袋耷拉着，唯一露在外面的双眼紧闭，眼角有鲜红渗出，血液从面具下巴处不停滴落。草！你不是除害来的吗？你这干嘛呢？这里不让睡觉！许牧心中暗骂面具人不靠谱，拉人下副本，团长倒头就睡。从这家伙的派头看，实力不会太弱，原以为他要装波帅的，结果就这么拉了坨大的，不过这也再次证明了‘精神序列’抵抗昏迷、蛊惑、幻觉的含金量。“他能给我什么？哈哈哈哈哈！！！”女孩开始疯癫地狂笑起来。“我让你看看他能给我什么，哈哈哈哈！！！”她猛地撩起了T恤下摆，露出肚子。“他给了我这个！！！”她恶狠狠地咬牙说道。女孩的小腹位置开始以肉眼可见的速度隆起，皮肤时而凸起，时而凹陷，里面仿佛在蠕动着成千上万条蛆虫，正在酝酿着、积蓄着力量，准备破皮而出。很快，那个肚子就跟怀胎十月的孕妇相差不大，唯一区别就是女孩的肚子里依旧在蠕动着什么，酝酿着什么。许牧知道事情已经失控了，继续待在这里可能……不，一定会死。女孩父亲又愤怒又恐惧，他倒退两步，悲恨交加地嘶吼道：“你……你想干什么！！你个不孝女！！我是你爸！”女孩母亲在男人身后哭喊道：“造孽啊！！家门不幸啊！呜啊啊啊！！早知道就把她掐死算了。”许牧摇了摇脑袋，让自已清醒了点，一把拉起面具人，架着他跌跌撞撞绕过茶几，摇摇晃晃走向门口。噗噗噗！嗤嗤嗤！爆发了。女孩的肚子开始钻出一条条状若白蛆的乳白色触手，它们密密麻麻，扭曲交缠，缓慢蠕动中，不时滴落粘稠液体。“不，你不能……啊！！！”女孩父亲张大嘴巴，话没说完，几十条乳白触手同时伸长，戳进他嘴里，直接贯穿了后脑。女孩母亲吓得忘记了尖叫，呆在原地。嗖！啪！一根触手如鞭横扫过去，她的头颅高高飞起，血柱喷上天花板，染红了吊灯，染红了橘黄光线，整个客厅如血月笼罩，充满猩红。“为什么要事事针对我！”“为什么逼我做不喜欢的事！！”“为什么我怎么做你们都不满意！！！”“为什么要那样说我的肖凡哥哥！！！！”“他可是我的神啊……”数不清的乳白触手或刺，或拍，或扫，不停地发泄着女孩的怒火，怨恨，痛苦。许牧一把推开防盗门，眼角余光看到客厅中央只剩两堆模糊不堪的血肉。他踉跄着来到楼梯前，一把将面具人推了下去，让他像车轮一样滚到下一层，自已则扶着栏杆，狼狈往下。重复这个过程，许牧终于带着面具人来到了一层。“两位小哥哥，你们怎么这么着急走啊，咯咯咯。”女孩咯咯笑着，声音回荡于整栋单元楼里，穿透层层钢筋水凝土，像箭矢插在许牧心脏。“咯咯咯，虽然你们给我的感觉不错，但肖凡哥哥说过，看见我这个样子的人，除了他……”“都得死！！！！”她声音忽地像恐怖电影里突脸的女鬼一样尖锐，层层荡漾，挥之不去。
content_en: An Hongfu was about to speak, but for a moment he didn't know whether to agree or disagree.His troubled eyes wandered back and forth between Feng Huajin and the mysterious man.The mysterious man noticed something strange about An Hongfu, and the eyes exposed in the mask looked sharply at Feng Huajin.Their eyes met, the air was unusually quiet, and An Hongfu, who was a little dumbfounded behind the counter, felt a tense atmosphere.At this time, the mysterious man suddenly raised his right hand and waved forward. The glass door behind him opened automatically in an instant. He took the opportunity to jump out of the convenience store and ran away.Feng Huajin also rushed out of the door and followed closely. In the blink of an eye, the two of them were already fifty meters away.An Hongfu stretched his neck and leaned his head forward. He rubbed his eyes in disbelief, feeling that he was dreaming.On the main section of Jinhui Street, two swift figures were flying quickly one after the other."Stop! In fact, we can talk!" Feng Huajin shouted to the figure in front.The mysterious man did not look back. He raised his sword finger, and the trash cans, gravel, branches and leaves on the street moved with him. They miraculously floated in the air. As the mysterious man pointed back, they quickly crashed into Feng Huajin behind him.Feng Huajin nimbly dodged the smelly trash cans and other objects, but found that he was gradually being distanced from him.The mysterious man seized this opportunity and wanted to increase his speed and throw away the pursuers behind him in one fell swoop.But the next second, he stepped on the ground with one foot and stopped the other in mid-air. He kept running and stood still in place."Xiaojin, I have him under control!" Lu Jianxing's voice sounded from the shadow of the mysterious man.Hearing the sound, Feng Huajin no longer worried about the obstacles that might fly at any time, and suddenly jumped out and rushed towards the mysterious man.The mysterious man's pupils shrank and he saw his own shadow being tightly grasped by a demonic claw-like hand.No matter how strong his consciousness was, his body seemed not to belong to him and he could not move at all.Seeing Feng Huajin about to rush over, the mysterious man silently recited a spell in his heart: Transform into water!The water around him rippled, and the mysterious man's body suddenly melted, falling to the ground with a crash to form a pool of fluid, flowing forward at a slow speed, aiming at the sewer manhole cover in front.His shadow also disappeared, and Lu Jianxing, who had lost his shadow, appeared out of thin air.Lu Jianxing saw the pool of fluid quickly drilling in along the gap in the manhole cover. He raised his hand and slashed through the air, and a vaguely outlined wind blade struck the remaining fluid.But this did not stop the fluid from escaping. The smoke from the slash dissipated. He rushed to the manhole cover and found many shallow slash marks on the ground, as well as a bright red blood stain.Feng Huajin arrived shortly after and saw the marks on the ground and said, "He is injured. Have you marked his shadow?" "Yes, he is running away towards the South District." Lu Jianxing closed his eyes and answered.Feng Huajin nodded, thought for a while, and continued to ask: "Are you going to chase? Or organize people to arrest him?" "I... uh..." Just as Lu Jianxing was about to speak, his whole body suddenly shook, and blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.Feng Huajin immediately supported him and asked hurriedly: "You were also injured. When?" "It's okay. You'll be fine soon. It was that guy who broke my shadow mark. He is very strong." Lu Jianxing wiped the corner of his mouth.After confirming that Lu Jianxing was fine, Feng Huajin breathed a sigh of relief and said, "Well, according to An Hongfu's description, he should be from a heretical organization that we have never come into contact with before." As she spoke, she placed her hands on Lu Jianxing's chest, and radiating light shone out of her palms.Lu Jianxing felt warmth spread all over his body, and the injury he suffered when the shadow mark was broken was quickly healed."Thank you, I'm much better." He smiled to express his gratitude.Feng Huajin slowly took back her hands, tucked a strand of hair behind her ears and asked, "What should we do now?" "Go back first and ask An Hongfu to sign a confidentiality agreement, and then return to the bureau to report the situation to the captain." "Well, let's go." ... Qingteng City, South District, Xingfu Community.Xu Mu, who was sleeping soundly, felt someone yelling around him, which made him extremely irritable and he woke up slowly."No money! Star chasing has turned me into a fucking waste! If you want to buy tickets, make your own money!" "Don't you even have 1,000 yuan! I just want to watch a concert. What's wrong!" "You are already in the third year of high school! Your grades are already at the bottom, can you focus on your studies!" Xu Mu opened his eyes and found that he was sitting on the sofa in the living room, with three strangers standing opposite the coffee table.It was the content of this argument that he was extremely familiar with.Wait, isn't this the content of the 401 family's quarrel? Why did they come to my living room to quarrel?Xu Mu's forehead twitched in response to this presumptuous family of three. No matter how good-tempered he was, he couldn't help but get angry at this moment.Suddenly, he noticed something was wrong. The layout of the room was wrong. This was not his living room.Could it be that I was the one taking the liberty?I came to someone's living room in the middle of the night?Xu Mu was immediately discouraged, felt guilty, and looked around hurriedly.Twisting his neck to the right, he saw another person sitting next to him. This person was crossing his legs and leaning back on the sofa chair in a relaxed and comfortable manner.His attire is very alternative: baseball cap, white smiley mask, brown leather jacket, khaki overalls, and black combat boots.Yo?There is still battle damage on the left shoulder. The damage, the wounds, and the blood stains really look like that.The tip of his nose twitched, and Xu Mu smelled the smell of blood.This is a real wound!Xu Mu suddenly woke up.He concluded that the masked man next to him was definitely not a member of this family. He was an outsider just like himself.Could it be that my appearance in someone else's living room has something to do with him?"Stop thinking blindly, we are now in the subconscious space of the girl in front of us." A bright voice came from under the mask.Xu Mu could not sense any malice in his tone. He looked at the senior girl in the living room and asked the masked man: "Why the two of us? I mean, why did she drag us into her subconscious space?" "You misunderstood her. In fact, I was the one who pulled us into her subconscious space." The masked man answered casually.Politeness: You?Xu Mu almost cursed. He pinched the Qingming point and was speechless: "Give me an explanation." "Hey, I'm sorry, do you believe me when I say I didn't mean it?" The masked man leaned forward, poured a cup of tea, and pushed it to Xu Mu, "I have one thingExtraordinary items, it can pull all extraordinary things within a certain range into the collective subconscious space."Originally, I just wanted to bring myself and her in, but I didn't expect that you, an extraordinary person, would be around here," he explained carelessly."It's inconsistent. Just now you said 'her subconscious space', but now it's the 'collective subconscious space'." Xu Mu immediately exposed it.The masked man laughed and replied: "This is not a contradiction. The collective subconscious space is like a server. All of our subconscious can be connected here." He looked at the quarrel in the living room and continued: "It's just that my extraordinary items can focus on her subconscious. We are watching her story, so it is not wrong to say that this is her subconscious space." Xu Mu thought for a moment, pointed at the girl's parents and said: "Are they also extraordinary?" "No, they are the girl's subconscious., similar to an illusion, their own subconscious is not here." The masked man explained without thinking, "There are only you, me, and her in this space." Xu Mu vaguely guessed something, got up from the sofa and asked, "I don't want to get involved in the grudges between you."How should I leave here?""You can find a way to leave by yourself, or wait for me to finish the work and use extraordinary items to clear this space."The masked man looked at Xu Mu, "Also, this is not a grudge, but a harm removal?"Xu Mu asked in surprise.The masked man also stood up from the sofa, nodded and said, "Yes, she can no longer be called a human being. She is a monster contaminated by out-of-control extraordinary factors." Monster... Xu Mu turned his head and looked at the girl in disbelief.Snap!A slap hit the girl's face.The girl's father's palms couldn't stop shaking, and he pointed at the girl and cursed: "At least we can provide you with food and clothes. What can that sissy star you chase give you?! He wants to act but he has no acting skills! He can't even sing out of tune! He is a waste! Without those brainless fans, he can't evenNot as good as a wild dog, what do you like about such a person!How dare you take our money to please a useless wild dog!!" The left side of the girl's face was marked with red palm prints, and her chest heaved violently as she tilted her head."Ahhhhhhh!!!" She suddenly screamed with a ferocious face.The sound penetrated the ears like a demonic sound, causing Xu Mu and the masked man to cover their ears at the same time."Don't say that to my brother Xiao Fan!!!
